deadline.value: Fall-only admission; all admission materials are due December 1.
deadline.quote: Fall Semester Only - The deadline for receipt of all admission materials is December 1 of each year for admission

also.quote: The Application Deadline for the Psychological and Brain Sciences Program is December 1.

gre_general.value: Psychological and Brain Sciences Ph.D. webpage, Bulletin entry, and Graduate School profile PDF do not state a GRE General requirement.

gre_subject.value: Department webpages and profile PDF do not state whether the ETS GRE Psychology Subject Test is required, optional, or not required.

supervisor.value: Uses a mentorship/apprenticeship model where each student works continuously with a faculty member, and the personal statement requires naming which faculty member(s) you would like to work with and why.
supervisor.quote: It also has an apprenticeship model in which each student works closely and continuously with a faculty member within the realm of the faculty member's research interests. | Describe your interest in the biological basis of behavior, any prior research experience, your career goals, and which faculty member(s) you would like to work with and why

funding.value: Ph.D. students receive a Graduate Teaching Assistantship ($21,000/year stipend plus tuition remission up to $28,872/year) in Years 1 and 2; funding in later years is not guaranteed and may come from grants or teaching.
funding.quote: Students in the Ph.D. program receive a Graduate Teaching Assistantship ($21,000/year stipend + tuition remission) in their first and second year. Funding in later years is not guaranteed, but could come from grant funding and/or teaching courses.

entry_route.value: Requires at least a bachelor's degree before enrollment (minimum 3.0 overall GPA, 3.2 in psychology courses, and >= 12 undergraduate psychology/neuroscience credits); up to 30 prior graduate credit hours may transfer toward the 60-credit Ph.D.
entry_route.quote: Successful applicants must have completed at least a baccalaureate degree before beginning the program.

also.quote: A minimum of 60 credit hours are required for the degree program. A maximum of 30 hours credit may be transferred.

notes: Ph.D. in Psychology — Psychological and Brain Sciences (CIP 42.2799, STEM OPT eligible; biological basis of behavior, psychophysiology, psychopharmacology, neuroendocrinology, cognitive neuroscience, neuropsychology). UMSL's Clinical Community Psychology Ph.D. is excluded as clinical practice, and Industrial/Organizational Psychology Ph.D. is suspended.
